rachel: Heads-up: deploy-bot tripped a freeze-override suggestion for change-window 03/25 22:00 due to sudden latency regressions on quantized builds. https://grafana/alert/quant-4600 :warning:

deploy-bot: autopilot:freeze_override_suggested for rollout/2026-03-25T22:00:00Z reason: quant_p95_delta>200ms. Action: human confirm rollback or apply `quant_disable_per_model` flag.

sam: copying @ivy @ops-lead. Quick triage shows regressions only on quantized variant v11-qc. Non-quant v11 stable fine.

ivy: can we flip `quant_fastpath=false` on a single canary node to see impact? If that helps, we can avoid full rollback.
sales-ops: FYI some enterprise customers in the change-window region have scheduled demos tonight; need comms if we rollback.

ops-lead: proposal: do not auto-rollback. Step 1: flip quant flag on one node, monitor 5m. Step 2: if stable, roll flag across canary slices. Step 3: if not stable, run targeted revert of quantized variant `releases/revert --model v11-qc --to v11-stable --slice canary:50%`.

rachel: decision: hold freeze override. Ivy to flip flag; Sam to prepare targeted revert CLI and customer one-liner. Keep change-window notified if we escalate.

ivy: flipping flag now on node-c: `runtime/flags set quant_fastpath=false --node node-c`

(deploy updates)

ivy: node-c metrics look good after flip. p95 down ~180ms on that node.
sam: prepared revert command and short customer note: "We routed some requests away from a quantized variant to restore latency; investigating a quant kernel path. We'll provide an update."

ops-lead: if we see no regressions in 10m, keep canary and schedule a safe rollforward after kernel tweak. If regressions persist, execute revert and notify Sales Ops for customer comms.

rachel: thanks everyone. freezing wide broadcast. Leave this hold open until postmortem scheduled.
